jobs.title: Summer 2027 Internship - Data Engineering
jobs.description:
**2027 Summer Internship Program**

Would you like to work for an organization committed to your professional development and personal success? John Burns Research and Consulting is an award-winning “Best Place to Work” that invests in our people through learning opportunities, professional experiences, and peer mentorship.

John Burns Research and Consulting is looking for talented students who are passionate, articulate, likable, and smart to provide the most trusted source of U.S. housing analysis and help our clients make the most informed decisions possible.

The Burns Internship provides meaningful work experiences and ongoing support and guidance to ensure you have valuable experience and prepare you for a professional career.

This Data Engineering intern will be working with our Data Engineering, Data Science and Technology groups. This is an in-person internship in our Irvine, California office.

**Program Details:**

As an **intern**, you'll begin the summer orientation delivered by experienced team members, similar to the training received by new employees. You will be working on real-time client projects, as well as a capstone project. Your capstone project will be a significant, strategic project that aligns with our real business needs and initiatives. At the end of your 10-week internship, you will do a final presentation of your capstone project, and what you learned throughout your internship.

There will be two possible start dates for our 2027 internship program:

* May 26th – August 6th
* June 16th – August 27th

(If the dates don’t work 100% for you, please still apply, and we can discuss.)

* Interns will work 40 hours per week, in our Irvine, California office.
* Salary is $25/hour.
* Positions will be posted for students to apply in October, and each position will be posted for two weeks.
  + Positions will be posted until Friday, November 6th, 2026
  + Offers will be extended by Friday, December 18th, 2026

**What you will learn:**

* Understanding our organization, industry, clients, and professional experience by working with our team members on their daily tasks.
* The opportunity to develop professional and technical skills necessary for success in the business world by working with teams within our company.

**Projects our interns may be working on:**

* Write code to fetch data from sources
* Use SQL Server and Azure Data Factory to load production-ready data
* Develop data cleaning steps in Python/Pandas
* Troubleshoot data pipelines that fail
* Reading and de-bugging existing SQL Stored Procedures
* Use Databricks to load production data and troubleshooting.

**How Do You Qualify?**

The Burns Internship Program is designed for high-performing students. We prefer candidates who meet the following criteria:

* Cumulative GPA: 3.3
* Major GPA: 3.3
* Rising seniors and graduate students (Graduating Spring 2027 – Spring 2028)
* Preferred Fields of study: computer science, statistics, mathematics, data science, or related field
* Proficiency in coding (python, pandas, SQL)
* Interest or experience in economics as pertains to the housing market
* Knowledge of building predictive models (time-series methods, machine learning methods)
* Willing to work with messy data
* Basic Excel skills
* Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to manage multiple tasks
* Collaborative team player
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Keen eye for details
* A strong work ethic
* A great attitude
* A willingness to learn new skills
* Exceptional time management skills to effectively prioritize tasks and meet deadlines

**To apply for the position, you must submit a cover letter and resume. Please explain why you are interested in this internship program and what you hope to gain from it.**

Join our team at John Burns Research and Consulting, LLC, a leading provider of independent subscription research and customized consulting services for the U.S. housing industry. Our founder, John Burns, started the company in 2001 with the aim of revolutionizing the housing market analysis. Today, we have a team of highly passionate research analysts and consultants nationwide who work together to provide the most trusted source of U.S. housing analysis and consulting services.

At John Burns Research and Consulting, LLC, we are proud of our award-winning culture, which includes recognition as Great Places to Work, Gallup Employee Engagement, Certified Evergreen by the Tugboat Institute, and Great Places to Work. If you want to be part of a well-established, dynamic, and high-performing team that takes it to the next level, this is the perfect opportunity for you.

### **Company Description**

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at **Intuitive**. As a global leader in **robotic-assisted surgery** and **minimally invasive care**, our technologies—like the **da Vinci surgical system** and **Ion**—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help **transform the future of healthcare**, you’ll find your purpose here.

We’re looking for a Software Engineer who is passionate about building a modern, scalable Data as a Service (DaaS) platform that powers Intuitive’s Digital products and supports over 2,000 engineers across the organization. In this role, you will own and evolve critical components of our real-time and micro-batch data pipelines that power product development, internal tools, and analytics.

Your work will focus on enabling high-throughput, low-latency data delivery through streaming pipelines, dynamic transformations, and APIs, driving discoverability, accessibility, and actionable insights. You will help define the architecture and engineering practices that support self-service analytics and operational decision-making on scale.

As a catalyst for change, you will be at the forefront of reimagining how engineering teams consume and interact with data. Long-term success in this role means building robust, efficient systems and replacing legacy processes with modern solutions that allow teams to move faster, with greater confidence and autonomy.

Responsibilities:

* Design and build scalable, distributed Data as a Service that ingest, process, and serve data from robotics, manufacturing, engineering, and clinical sources in real time and batch modes.
* Develop and maintain robust APIs, data services, and tooling to provide internal teams with secure, efficient, and intuitive access to high-quality data.
* Partner with engineering, analytics, and business stakeholders to evolve data contracts and models that support emerging use cases and ensure semantic consistency.
* Implement CI/CD practices for data services, including automated testing for data quality, service reliability, and schema evolution.
* Championing a self-service data culture by building discoverable, well-documented data products and guiding teams toward empowered, autonomous data access.
* Act as a technical leader within the data domain driving best practices, mentoring teammates, and continuously improving how data is produced, shared, and consumed across the organization.

* Solid quantitative background in Computer Science, Engineering, Physics, Math, or 3+ years of hands-on experience in a technically demanding role.

* Strong collaborator who actively contributes to code reviews, system design discussions, sprint planning, and KPI evaluations to drive team excellence and technical quality.
* Minimum a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, information technology, or a related field.

Bonus Points:

* Experience working on Data Platform or Infrastructure Engineering teams.

The Ground Communications and Architecture Section (361) provides engineering development, implementation, and maintenance of high-reliability state-of-the-art technologies for the telecommunications systems of the Deep Space Network (DSN) in support of NASA's space and science missions. Our engineers design and develop all aspects of the ground communications systems including the Radio Frequency (RF) microwave optics and feeds, cryogenic low noise amplifiers, high power RF transmitters, digital receivers, mechanical/structural elements of large antennas and antenna construction, and precision antenna pointing utilizing advanced servo controllers.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to build and sustain software for DSN embedded platforms and operational ground systems. The role spans embedded Linux and server-side work, supporting systems the DSN relies on every day. You will be a member of the Control Systems and Electronics Group (361F) and will work closely with teammates across the organization to provide support through all phases of the DSN project lifecycle, from inception through the end of maturity.

* Implements cybersecurity requirements and recommendations in embedded software systems.
* Contributes to technical documentation and participates in code reviews and design reviews to ensure high-quality software deliverables.
* Develops and maintains the WebCMD service as part of the Telemetry, Tracking, and Command software suite.

* Works with DSN operations and flight project teams to gather requirements and deliver updates.

* High proficiency in Java and database experience.
* Deep knowledge of Python and Bash scripting for tooling, system administration, and troubleshooting.
* Experience with kernel configuration and cross-compilation toolchains for embedded architectures.
* Familiarity with Docker containerization for development and build environments.
* Familiarity implementing cybersecurity requirements in software systems.
* Familiarity with Git version control and software development workflows.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to work effectively as part of a small, collaborative team.
* Experience working on high-reliability or mission-critical systems.
* Ability to travel to domestic and foreign Deep Space Network sites for 1 to 2 weeks per year.

**DESIRED SKILLS**

* Prior experience with Buildroot or Yocto embedded build frameworks.
* Experience configuring Linux services (BusyBox init, systemd) and Linux system administration.

We combine serious space flight experience with an open minded, first-principles approach, leveraging advanced computational design and Industry 4.0 practices to deliver custom spacecraft and mission solutions with industry leading speed, precision, and reliability. We seek to enable every payload and mission with a fully custom, purpose-built spacecraft bus, designed and delivered using Proteus™, our patent-pending, automated computational design platform, with industry leading reliability.

**Role Description**

We are seeking an Embedded Flight Software Engineer with deep expertise in low-level embedded software, FPGA interfaces, drivers, and bootloader development to join our flight program team. This is a full-time, in-office role for an experienced professional with a proven track record of hands-on FSW development. In this role, you will design and implement low-level drivers, BSPs, and boot systems while managing memory architectures and FPGA hardware interfaces. You will bridge the gap between low-level hardware and high-level FSW logic, ensuring reliable spacecraft boot behavior, fail-safe recovery, and deterministic bus communications in space environments.

**Key Responsibilities**.

* Develop low-level C/C++ drivers, Board Support Packages (BSPs), and hardware interfaces for microcontrollers, FPGAs, and standard communication buses.
* Design and implement stage-1 and stage-2 bootloaders, robust boot behaviors, partition swapping logic, and fail-safe recovery modes.
* Architect memory management strategies across volatile and non-volatile memory (NOR/NAND Flash, SRAM, EEPROM) to preserve data integrity across reboots.
* Configure low-level communication protocols and bus interfaces (e.g., SPI, I2C, CAN, UART, SpaceWire, or PCIe) between compute units, peripherals, and payloads.
* Implement telemetry collection, time synchronization, and task scheduling within RTOS or embedded OS environments.
* Execute hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing and debugging on flatsats using logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and FPGA emulator tools.
* Manage the codebase using modern version control systems and contribute to CI/CD workflows for automated testing and continuous integration.
* Execute comprehensive test campaigns on testbeds and flight units to verify software performance under flight-like conditions.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate subsystems with the spacecraft main compute element.
* Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.
* Document design processes, test results, and system performance.
* Provide technical guidance on FSW architectures to fellow engineers, fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or advanced degree in computer science, aerospace engineering, or similar field.
* 5+ years of embedded software engineering experience, with exposure to low-level driver development, hardware integration, or bootloaders.
* Strong proficiency in C, C++, embedded Linux, and Real-Time Operating Systems (RTOS).
* Familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git) and automated testing/CI workflows.
